issues.summary: The backward-compatibility justification is confusing because adding FakeProcessGroup to `__all__` is new; explain or fix the claim.

Rewrite the comment so it says the store has to be a pure C++ object held by the C++ ProcessGroup, which is why it can't live in Python without extra indirection; the current comment argues the point too hard.
This change looks unnecessary because the new call above already guarantees a real options object; justify it or revert it.
This code logically merge-conflicts with main and is now dead code; remove it.
The fake PG accepts a case that NCCL treats as an error; it should match NCCL and raise an error instead of being more lenient.
